icons.name: Alfa (A)
icons.description: I have a diver down; keep well clear at slow speed.

icons.name: Bravo (B)
icons.description: I am taking in, discharging or carrying dangerous goods.

icons.name: Charlie (C)
icons.description: Affirmative.

icons.name: Delta (D)
icons.description: Keep clear of me; I am manoeuvring with difficulty.

icons.name: Echo (E)
icons.description: I am altering my course to starboard.

icons.name: Foxtrot (F)
icons.description: I am disabled; communicate with me.

icons.name: Golf (G)
icons.description: I require a pilot.

icons.name: Hotel (H)
icons.description: I have a pilot on board.

icons.name: India (I)
icons.description: I am altering my course to port.

icons.name: Juliett (J)
icons.description: I am on fire and have dangerous cargo on board; keep well clear.

icons.name: Kilo (K)
icons.description: I wish to communicate with you.

icons.name: Lima (L)
icons.description: You should stop your vessel instantly.

icons.name: Mike (M)
icons.description: My vessel is stopped and making no way through the water.

icons.name: November (N)
icons.description: Negative.

icons.name: Oscar (O)
icons.description: Man overboard.

icons.name: Papa (P)
icons.description: All persons should report on board; the vessel is about to proceed to sea.

icons.name: Quebec (Q)
icons.description: My vessel is healthy and I request free pratique.

icons.name: Romeo (R)
icons.description: No single-flag meaning in the International Code.

icons.name: Sierra (S)
icons.description: I am operating astern propulsion.

icons.name: Tango (T)
icons.description: Keep clear of me; I am engaged in pair trawling.

icons.name: Uniform (U)
icons.description: You are running into danger.

icons.name: Victor (V)
icons.description: I require assistance.

icons.name: Whiskey (W)
icons.description: I require medical assistance.

icons.name: X-ray (X)
icons.description: Stop carrying out your intentions and watch for my signals.

icons.name: Yankee (Y)
icons.description: I am dragging my anchor.

icons.name: Zulu (Z)
icons.description: I require a tug.
